boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named campus places with documented ways students eat, study, connect, or take part in campus recreation.

cards.title: Edward J. Pryzbyla University Center
cards.subtitle: Campus gathering place
cards.notes: Use the Pryz as a practical meeting point: it combines dining, student services, meeting rooms, an information desk, and campus activities in one building.
cards.short_summary: A central multi-use building for meals, errands, meetings, and student services.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University describes the Pryzbyla Center as the central gathering place for the campus community and lists multiple services and meeting rooms there.
cards.access_notes: Campus building; check building access and individual office schedules before visiting.

cards.title: Garvey Hall
cards.subtitle: University dining commons
cards.notes: Plan a meal with classmates in the 400-seat dining room, then use one of the three outdoor dining areas when conditions allow.
cards.short_summary: The undergraduate dining commons offers substantial shared indoor and outdoor seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University identifies Garvey Hall as its main undergraduate dining commons and states that it has a 400-seat dining room and three outdoor dining areas.
cards.source_title: Dining & Places to Eat | Catholic University
cards.access_notes: Dining service requires an applicable meal plan or other payment; consult Dining Services for current access and menus.

cards.title: Pryz Food Court
cards.subtitle: Inside the Pryzbyla University Center
cards.notes: Meet over lunch in the centrally located food court, whose listed options include Chick-fil-A and Which Wich.
cards.short_summary: A central quick-service dining stop within the university center.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University says the Food Court is in the Pryzbyla University Center and offers Chick-fil-A and Which Wich.
cards.source_title: Dining & Places to Eat | Catholic University
cards.access_notes: Food and beverages require purchase; verify current dining operations before going.

cards.title: Starbucks at the Pryz
cards.subtitle: Third floor, Pryzbyla University Center
cards.notes: Use the third-floor Starbucks as a clearly located coffee-and-snack stop while you are already in the university center.
cards.short_summary: A Starbucks location on the Pryz’s third floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University states that its Starbucks is on the third floor of the Edward J. Pryzbyla University Center.
cards.source_title: Dining & Places to Eat | Catholic University
cards.access_notes: Food and beverages require purchase; verify current dining operations before going.

cards.title: Pryz Market
cards.subtitle: First floor, Pryzbyla University Center
cards.notes: Pick up snacks, drinks, or a small campus-living essential at this first-floor market before heading to class or a study session.
cards.short_summary: A convenience market for snacks, drinks, and everyday campus essentials.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University says Pryz Market is on the first floor of the Pryzbyla University Center and sells snacks, drinks, and last-minute essentials.
cards.source_title: Dining & Places to Eat | Catholic University
cards.access_notes: Merchandise requires purchase; verify current dining operations before going.

cards.title: The Nest
cards.subtitle: Suite 300, Pryzbyla Center
cards.notes: Start an involvement question at The Nest, where the Center for Student Engagement, student government, graduate association, and Program Board are listed.
cards.short_summary: A named Pryzbyla Center hub for student engagement and representation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pryzbyla Center directory locates the Center for Student Engagement, Student Government Association, Graduate Student Association, and Program Board in The Nest, Suite 300.
cards.access_notes: Located in Suite 300; ask the Center for Student Engagement about current drop-in and organization hours.

cards.entity_name: John K. Mullen of Denver Memorial Library
cards.title: Mullen Library
cards.subtitle: Main campus library
cards.notes: Bring research questions to the information desk or arrange a deeper librarian consultation; the library also offers research workshops and course-related instruction.
cards.short_summary: The main research library, with help from librarians and access to consortium materials.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University’s graduate orientation guide states that research assistance is available at Mullen Library’s information desk, by phone and email, and through librarian consultations and workshops.
cards.source_title: Graduate Orientation Resource Guide | Catholic University
cards.access_notes: Library access and services may vary by user status and semester; consult library guidance before visiting.

cards.title: Caldwell 125 Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Caldwell Hall; Theology and Religious Studies graduate space
cards.notes: TRS graduate students can use the lounge’s tables, seating, quiet study room, and kitchen-style amenities for focused work or a low-key meal.
cards.short_summary: A designated Theology and Religious Studies graduate lounge with study and eating space.
cards.evidence_claim: The School of Theology and Religious Studies designates Caldwell 125 as a graduate lounge with tables, seating, a quiet study room, and amenities for studying and eating.
cards.source_title: Student Resources | Theology and Religious Studies Student Association
cards.access_notes: Designated for Theology and Religious Studies graduate students; keep noise low near the adjacent Dissertation Room.

cards.title: Kane Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Student fitness facility
cards.notes: Use the Kane Fitness Center for a self-directed workout during operating hours; eligible students sign in with the university app rather than scheduling an appointment.
cards.short_summary: A student-only fitness facility for drop-in workouts during open hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University states that Kane Fitness Center is for currently enrolled students, requires no appointment, and allows patrons to sign in during open operating hours.
cards.source_title: Policies, Rules, and Regulations | Catholic University Fitness and Recreation
cards.access_notes: Only currently enrolled students may use the facility; bring valid university credentials and check operating hours.

cards.title: Raymond A. DuFour Athletic Center
cards.subtitle: North-campus athletics complex
cards.notes: Reserve an available athletic facility or join a scheduled activity; the complex includes courts, pool, weight room, track, tennis courts, and outdoor fields.
cards.short_summary: A large athletics complex with indoor and outdoor recreation facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Catholic University lists the DuFour Center’s associated courts, pool, weight room, tracks, tennis courts, and playing fields, and says athletic facilities there are available by reservation.
cards.source_title: Policies, Rules, and Regulations | Catholic University Fitness and Recreation
cards.access_notes: Facility use is reservation-based and requires appropriate university access; follow current recreation policies.
